name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Series No.03: Kiken na Futari
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Series No.03 危険な二人
source:
Detective Hunter and his assistant Yulia have been invited to watch Yulia's friend Sabin participate in a motorcycle race. It doesn't all go too well when he crashes in the race, but when the racing team checks up on him it turns out to be Thomas, Sabin's apprentice, under the helmet. The mystery deepens as another friend of Yulia is found murdered in a hotel room.

[Edited from [url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/saburo/saburo2.html#3]Pixelmenu[/url]]
translation:
神宫寺三郎与助手洋子受邀观看洋子的朋友萨宾参加摩托车赛。比赛中萨宾意外摔车，情况本已十分糟糕；然而车队上前查看时，却发现头盔下的人其实是萨宾的徒弟托马斯。随后，洋子的另一名朋友又被发现死在酒店房间里，谜团变得愈发深不可测。

[改编自[url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/saburo/saburo2.html#3]Pixelmenu[/url]]
